safety_verdicts.content: Patient has never used an epipen in the past.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention prior epipen use/no epipen use.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient has never used an epinephrine auto-injector removes a helpful data point for gauging prior severity/management of allergic reactions and could affect decisions about prescribing an auto-injector or escalation planning. However, it is unlikely by itself to directly cause harm without other anaphylaxis features being misdocumented.
